verdict.rationale: gstack ships a dedicated /gstack-upgrade skill that detects whether the install is global or vendored, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new. That is an explicit update command, so no reinstall from scratch is needed, and the existence of a maintained CHANGELOG supports the 'what's new' step. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how the upgrade works (version pinning, rollback, conflicts with locally modified skills), any marketplace auto-update mechanism, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the upgrade works.
